title: Tenali Rama and the Priceless Gift
moral: True value lies in wisdom and loyalty, not in wealth.

scenes.text: The king asked his courtiers to bring the most valuable gift.
scenes.image_prompt: king announcing competition in royal court cartoon style

scenes.text: Courtiers brought gold, jewels, and rare treasures.
scenes.image_prompt: courtiers presenting gold and jewels to king cartoon

scenes.text: Tenali came without any physical gift.
scenes.image_prompt: Tenali standing empty handed while others laugh cartoon

scenes.text: Tenali said loyalty and wisdom are the most valuable gifts.
scenes.image_prompt: Tenali speaking confidently in court cartoon

scenes.summary: The king declares Tenali the winner.
scenes.text: The king agreed and rewarded Tenali for his wise answer.
scenes.image_prompt: king praising Tenali while others look surprised cartoon

story: The king asked for the most valuable gift. While others brought riches, Tenali offered loyalty and wisdom. The king declared him the winner, teaching that true value is not in wealth.
